summaries.zh: LLM-native code toolkit: Rust multi-language parser (tree-sitter) + 44 MCP tools for atomic editing, impact analysis, reference tracing and deterministic zero-LLM code quality gates. Built for the handless, eyeless, memoryless LLM.
